issues: The fixed extra end-of-month contribution was calculated by dividing the balance shortfall directly by 240 months ($199,954.26 / 240 = $833.14) without incorporating the 0.5% monthly compound interest rate over 240 months; using the annuity future value factor ((1.005^240 - 1) / 0.005 ≈ 462.0409), the correct fixed payment is approximately $432.77 ($432.7631... unrounded).
reviews.reason: The advisor calculated the extra monthly contribution by simple division over 240 months instead of using the annuity formula with monthly compound interest.
